# router

Types from PocketBase's Go package `router`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [router](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/router).

## router.ApiError

ApiError defines the struct for a basic api error response.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> |  |
| `message` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `status` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `error()` | <code>(): string</code> | Error makes it compatible with the `error` interface. |
| `rawData()` | <code>(): any</code> | RawData returns the unformatted error data (could be an internal error, text, etc.) |
| `is()` | <code>(target: Error): boolean</code> | Is reports whether the current ApiError wraps the target. |

## router.Event

Has everything <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookevent">hook.Event</a></code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `response` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/http#httpresponsewriter">http.ResponseWriter</a></code> |  |
| `request?` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/http#httprequest">http.Request</a></code> |  |
| `written()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | Written reports whether the current response has already been written. |

| `remoteIP()` | <code>(): string</code> | RemoteIP returns the IP address of the client that sent the request. |
| `findUploadedFiles()` | <code>(key: string): Array&lt;(<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemfile">filesystem.File</a> &#124; undefined)&gt;</code> | FindUploadedFiles extracts all form files of "key" from a http request and returns a slice with filesystem.File instances (if any). |
| `get()` | <code>(key: string): any</code> | Get retrieves single value from the current event data store. |
| `getAll()` | <code>(): { [key: string]: any }</code> | GetAll returns a copy of the current event data store. |
| `set()` | <code>(key: string, value: any): void</code> | Set saves single value into the current event data store. |
| `setAll()` | <code>(m: { [key: string]: any }): void</code> | SetAll saves all items from m into the current event data store. |
| `string()` | <code>(status: number, data: string): void</code> | String writes a plain string response. |
| `html()` | <code>(status: number, data: string): void</code> | HTML writes an HTML response. |
| `json()` | <code>(status: number, data: any): void</code> | JSON writes a JSON response. |
| `xml()` | <code>(status: number, data: any): void</code> | XML writes an XML response. It automatically prepends the generic `xml.header` string to the response. |
| `stream()` | <code>(status: number, contentType: string, reader: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#ioreader">io.Reader</a>): void</code> | Stream streams the specified reader into the response. |
| `blob()` | <code>(status: number, contentType: string, b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> | Blob writes a blob (bytes slice) response. |
| `fileFS()` | <code>(fsys: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/fs#fsfs">fs.FS</a>, filename: string): void</code> | FileFS serves the specified filename from fsys. |
| `noContent()` | <code>(status: number): void</code> | NoContent writes a response with no body (ex. 204). |
| `redirect()` | <code>(status: number, url: string): void</code> | Redirect writes a redirect response to the specified url. The status code must be in between 300 – 399 range. |
| `error()` | <code>(status: number, message: string, errData: any): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerapierror">ApiError</a>)</code> |  |
| `badRequestError()` | <code>(message: string, errData: any): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerapierror">ApiError</a>)</code> |  |
| `notFoundError()` | <code>(message: string, errData: any): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerapierror">ApiError</a>)</code> |  |
| `forbiddenError()` | <code>(message: string, errData: any): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerapierror">ApiError</a>)</code> |  |
| `unauthorizedError()` | <code>(message: string, errData: any): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerapierror">ApiError</a>)</code> |  |
| `tooManyRequestsError()` | <code>(message: string, errData: any): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerapierror">ApiError</a>)</code> |  |
| `internalServerError()` | <code>(message: string, errData: any): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerapierror">ApiError</a>)</code> |  |
| `bindBody()` | <code>(dst: any): void</code> | BindBody unmarshal the request body into the provided dst. |

## router.RouterGroup

RouterGroup represents a collection of routes and other sub groups
that share common pattern prefix and middlewares.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `prefix` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `middlewares` | <code>Array&lt;(<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookhandler">hook.Handler</a>&lt;T&gt; &#124; undefined)&gt;</code> |  |
| `group()` | <code>(prefix: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup">RouterGroup</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | Group creates and register a new child Group into the current one with the specified prefix. |
| `bindFunc()` | <code>(...middlewareFuncs: ((e: T) =&gt; void)[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup">RouterGroup</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | BindFunc registers one or multiple middleware functions to the current group. |
| `bind()` | <code>(...middlewares: (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookhandler">hook.Handler</a>&lt;T&gt; &#124; undefined)[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup">RouterGroup</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | Bind registers one or multiple middleware handlers to the current group. |
| `unbind()` | <code>(...middlewareIds: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup">RouterGroup</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | Unbind removes one or more middlewares with the specified id(s) from the current group and its children (if any). |
| `route()` | <code>(method: string, path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | Route registers a single route into the current group. |
| `any()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | Any is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with "" as route method (aka. matches any method). |
| `get()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | GET is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with GET as route method. |
| `search()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | SEARCH is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with SEARCH as route method. |
| `post()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | POST is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with POST as route method. |
| `delete()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | DELETE is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with DELETE as route method. |
| `patch()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | PATCH is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with PATCH as route method. |
| `put()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | PUT is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with PUT as route method. |
| `head()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | HEAD is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with HEAD as route method. |
| `options()` | <code>(path: string, action: (e: T) =&gt; void): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroute">Route</a>&lt;T&gt;)</code> | OPTIONS is a shorthand for [`RouterGroup.addRoute`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerroutergroup) with OPTIONS as route method. |
| `hasRoute()` | <code>(method: string, path: string): boolean</code> | HasRoute checks whether the specified route pattern (method + path) is registered in the current group or its children. |
